How does asyncio work in Python?

Python's asyncio provides a single-threaded, cooperative event loop that executes tasks concurrently.

Key Concepts

  • Event Loop: The central manager orchestrating coroutines and I/O callbacks.
  • Coroutines: Functions defined with async def.

Can you show a short code snippet?

Here is an example using asyncio.run() and asyncio.gather():

import asyncio

async def fetch_data(id):
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    return {"id": id, "status": "ok"}

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(fetch_data(1), fetch_data(2))
    print(results)

asyncio.run(main())
